answer.text:
Intel Foundry’s external revenue fell **about 60%** in 2024 compared with 2023.

**Calculation:** ($953 million − $385 million) ÷ $953 million × 100 = **59.6% decline**.

Intel attributed the decrease primarily to **lower traditional packaging services revenue and lower equipment sales**. (Intel 2024 Form 10-K, accession **0000050863-25-000009**, “Operating Segment Revenue Summary,” chunk **00cec489-cca7-51ce-a50a-2814f0bd9f87**; external revenue figures also in “Note 3: Operating Segments,” chunk **d3c83be6-139e-5d68-8f94-47134294ebb5**.)
